data.hook: Jalen Hurts tossed three touchdown passes to seal a tight win, but Washington's bone-crushing defensive hits had fans buzzing with memes and hype.
data.name: Eagles Edge Commanders 24-22 in Opener as Hits Steal Spotlight
data.summary: The Philadelphia Eagles kicked off their season with a 24-22 victory over the Washington Commanders at Lincoln Financial Field, thanks to Hurts' 203 yards and scores to Dallas Goedert twice and rookie Dontayvion Wicks on a 64-yard bomb and 9-yard touchdown. Washington rallied late with Jayden Daniels' two fourth-quarter touchdowns, including a 1-yard score to Antonio Williams, but Philly stopped the two-point try to hold on. Defensive standouts like rookie linebacker Sonny Styles' massive hit and Tyler Owens' special teams play drew endless replays, memes calling them a 'menace' and 'the Hulk,' while the Eagles celebrated their 'DUB.'

data.summary: The Bears travel to Charlotte for a 1 p.m. ET kickoff against the Carolina Panthers at Bank of America Stadium, airing on FOX. Both teams ride momentum from 2025—Chicago's NFC North title at 11-6 and Carolina's NFC South win at 8-9—with the Bears as slight road favorites. Wide receiver Rome Odunze is expected to play despite a questionable calf tag, boosting excitement alongside tailgates, locker room hype, and good-luck nods from local media. Fans on both sides mix nerves with big hopes for their young stars like Williams and Bryce Young.

data.hook: Jalen Hurts aired out deep passes while Commanders rookie Sonny Styles crushed Saquon Barkley on his way to a sack, turning the NFC East clash into a fan-favorite slugfest.
data.name: Eagles Edge Commanders 23-16 in Physical Season Opener
data.summary: At Lincoln Financial Field, the Eagles jumped ahead early with Hurts' touchdown throws to Dontayvion Wicks and Dallas Goedert, leaning on their passing attack to build a lead. Styles stole the show for Washington with a thunderous hit on Barkley and his first NFL sack on Hurts, as Jayden Daniels scrambled to keep the Commanders close with a late score to Stefon Diggs. Philadelphia held firm for a 23-16 win, with Hurts later praising the team's 'Great Passion, Great Execution, Great Focus' in a sideline clip that spread quickly.

data.hook: Jalen Hurts dropped three touchdown passes, and the defense stuffed a game-winning two-point try to hand the Eagles a narrow victory at home.
data.name: Eagles Edge Commanders 24-22 in Season Opener Thriller
data.summary: Philadelphia beat Washington 24-22 at Lincoln Financial Field to open the 2026 NFL season 1-0. Hurts went 14-of-25 for 203 yards with scores to Dallas Goedert twice and debutant Dontayvion Wicks, who snagged a 64-yard bomb and a 9-yard touchdown. Jayden Daniels rallied the Commanders late with a touchdown to make it 24-22, but Moro Ojomo stopped the two-point conversion. Hurts praised the team's passion, execution, and focus after the win, as Philly eyes the Titans next.

data.hook: As the national anthem played at Acrisure Stadium, two NASA T-38 jets streaked overhead, thrilling a packed crowd of Steelers fans under clear Pittsburgh skies.
data.name: NASA Jets Soar Over Steelers Home Opener in Historic NFL Flyover
data.summary: NASA launched its Inspiration Tour with the first-ever agency flyover at an NFL game, sending supersonic T-38 trainers from Houston and Ohio over Acrisure Stadium before Pittsburgh's win against Atlanta. The jets, used by Artemis astronauts, took off from Pittsburgh International Airport and passed during the anthem, with NASA personnel in blue flight suits celebrating on the field. This NFL partnership will bring more flyovers, astronaut appearances, and exhibits to stadiums in Baltimore, Philadelphia, and New Jersey, aiming to inspire the next generation by linking space exploration with football.
